title: dots.tts.edit: Precisely Controlled Speech Editing with a Continuous Autoregressive Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.02673v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech editing for content creation requires precise control over both what an edit should do and where it should apply. Free-form natural language provides a flexible interface for expressing edit requests, but its ambiguity may leave the intended operation, parameters, or target region underspecified. We study a semi-formal transcript-grounded edit instruction that specifies operation categories and parameters and binds them to transcript spans or boundaries. This semantic timeline avoids explicit timestamp alignment and provides an externally inspectable contract for compositional edits. We instantiate the interface in dots$.$tts$.$edit, a speech editing model built on a continuous autoregressive speech generation architecture. Four representative speech-creation controls cover lexical content, affective expression, pitch and speaking-rate delivery, and temporal phrasing through text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing. Tas

translated_title: dots.tts.edit：基于连续自回归模型的精确可控语音编辑
translated_abstract: 面向内容创作的语音编辑需要对“编辑应做什么”以及“编辑应作用于何处”实现精确控制。自由形式的自然语言为表达编辑请求提供了灵活的接口，但其模糊性可能导致预期的操作、参数或目标区域定义不清。我们研究了一种半形式化的、基于转写文本的编辑指令，该指令明确指定操作类别和参数，并将其绑定到转写文本的片段或边界上。这种语义时间线避免了显式的时间戳对齐，并为组合式编辑提供了可从外部审查的契约。我们在 dots.tts.edit 中实现了该接口，这是一个基于连续自回归语音生成架构构建的语音编辑模型。四种代表性的语音创作控制涵盖了词汇内容、情感表达、音高与语速的呈现方式，以及通过文本、情感、韵律和停顿编辑实现的时间性措辞控制。
tldr: 提出了一种基于连续自回归架构的语音编辑模型 dots.tts.edit，通过半形式化的、基于转写文本的编辑指令，将操作类别与参数绑定到文本片段或边界，从而对文本、情感、韵律和停顿四类语音编辑实现“做什么”与“在哪里”的精确控制。
en_tdlr: dots.tts.edit is a speech editing model built on a continuous autoregressive architecture that uses semi-formal, transcript-grounded edit instructions to bind operations and parameters to transcript spans or boundaries, enabling precise control over what edits do—spanning text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing—and where they apply.
